subject.description: The subject this test is for (e.g. 'Math', 'Science', etc.). Applicable for subject-wise tests.

year.description: The year of the question paper, if applicable (for previous year papers).

options.description: Array of possible answer options for the question.

correctAnswerIndex.description: The index of the correct answer in the options array.

score.description: The user's score on the test.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to securely manage users, tests, questions, and user scores for the TNPSC Ace application. It prioritizes authorization independence and clear security rules.  User data is stored under `/users/{userId}` for private access. Tests are stored in a flat `/tests` collection to enable listing all tests without complex queries. Questions for each test are nested under `/tests/{testId}/questions/{questionId}` to ensure efficient retrieval of questions for a specific test. User test scores are stored under `/user_test_scores/{userTestScoreId}` and include denormalized `userId` and `testId` for efficient score retrieval and filtering.  This design avoids complex `get()` calls in security rules, facilitating atomic operations. Segregation ensures that different data types (users, tests, questions, scores) with varying access needs are stored in separate collections, simplifying security rules and ensuring that rules are not used as filters.  The structure enables secure list operations (QAPs) by storing Tests in a flat collection (no need for filtering based on user roles) and by using path-based ownership for User data.
